end.summary:
Reyansh practised identifying solid views from the top, front and side.
They matched all 7 views to objects correctly.
They gave 5 unaided correct answers out of 6 when describing views.
They first thought another person would see the same cup view, then corrected this after discussing the handle.
They explained that an object can look different from different places, but teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Reyansh practised describing and matching top, front and side views of solids, including cubes, cylinders, cones and spheres. Using familiar examples such as a ball, birthday cap and cup helped them explain the views; they also corrected the cup-handle mix-up during the lesson. At home, ask them to look at a cup or box from three places and draw what they see.
